description: North East Lincolnshire Council is a unitary authority. Default is procurement_paid. Heavy 'REDACTED PERSONAL INFORMATION' bucket (821+ rows in 2026/27 alone) — Care Act 2014 / UK GDPR direct payments to individuals — buckets to direct_payment_individual.

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions — direct payments to individuals (foster carers, SGO recipients, ASC service-user direct payments, CYP direct payments, Staying Put). NELincs uses 'REDACTED PERSONAL INFORMATION' as the canonical form. Lawfully unnamed.

Employer LGPS contributions to the East Riding Pension Fund (NEL's administering fund; East Riding of Yorkshire Council administers). 39 rows / £4.1M, including the ledger-labelled 'EAST RIDING PENSION FUND (ACCTY USE ONLY)'. Payroll-related transfer, not procurement — same treatment as Warwickshire's WCC Pension Fund rows. Added 6 Jul 2026 observational audit.
